text:
Lina H: Quick heads-up from the usability sessions — the onboarding checklist pushes important CTAs below the fold on narrow viewports. Screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc-mobile

Aria (PM): Good catch. Two proposals: compress into collapsible steps with persistent progress, or replace the full-width CTA with a small dismissible 'Try sample' chip to save space.

Ravi: Collapsible panels are fine if the next action is always visible. If collapsed, show "Step 1 of 3" + a micro progress bar. Avoid hiding the primary CTA.

Sam C: Accessibility note: ensure panels expose aria-expanded and aria-controls; panel headers must be keyboard-focusable with visible focus ring.

Elaine: Copy tweak: shorten "Try a sample project" -> "Try a sample" for mobile. Add microcopy under the chip: "Includes config + example prompts" to clarify value.

Lina H: Mobile pattern: stacked compact cards (icon + title + one-line blurb). Tapping expands inline rather than opening a modal to keep context.

Ravi: Implementation: fetch template metadata only on load, fetch template payload on expand. Use a /templates/manifest endpoint. Avoid downloading full assets until needed.

engbot: Event created: onboarding.checklist.interact with props {action,element,viewportWidth}.

Sam C: Dismiss control must be keyboard accessible and labeled "Dismiss quickstart" for screen readers. Also ensure reduced-motion respects system prefs for any chevron animation.

Aria (PM): Let's A/B test: Variant X = compact stacked cards with tap-to-expand; Variant Y = minimal banner + "See templates" modal. Measure: percent who create a project in-session and time-to-first-project.

Elaine: UX suggestion: add a subtle chevron animation on expandable cards to signal interactivity but keep it lightweight. I'll prototype a GIF.

Lina H: Small copy change for checklist header: "Finish setup (≈2 minutes)" — testers asked for time estimate.

Ravi: Back-end ETA: manifest endpoint + CDN hosting for starter artifacts ≈3 days. Frontend: accordion + analytics hook ≈2 days. QA + a11y pass ≈1 day. Total ~6 business days.

Sam C: For canary, I want an automated a11y smoke test (axe) and a keyboard walkthrough recording. I'll add a checklist to the PR template.

Aria (PM): Thanks — Lina, update Figma with stacked-card mocks + microcopy. Ravi flag when manifest is live so we can flip the variant flag. Scheduling a 20m handoff on Friday.

Lina H: Will update Figma and include the chevron gif and an a11y checklist. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
